item.title: Tecnologo: Southern Innovation Hub for Quantum Information (PIMIQ) (Univ. PARMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-02 23:59
Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-04 Fisica matematica

The Technologist will be employed in activities related to the functions of animation, marketing, and management of the infrastructure and technological services of the Innovation Cluster. In particular, the Technologist will be responsible for the preparation, validation, documentation, and provision of protocols and software tools for quantum computing. The activities will be aimed at producing tools, procedures, technical documentation, materials for testing and demonstration activities, as well as providing technical support for users in accessing and using the infrastructure and technological services of the Innovation Cluster.
